alerts_recipient_key_ck.name: alerts_recipient_key_ck
alerts_recipient_key_ck.value: "alerts"."recipient_key" = CASE WHEN "alerts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'u:' || "alerts"."user_id" ELSE 'c:' || "alerts"."contact_id" END

dl_window_ck.name: dl_window_ck
dl_window_ck.value: (("deadlines"."precision" = 'window') = ("deadlines"."window_start" IS NOT NULL AND "deadlines"."window_end" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("deadlines"."precision" <> 'window' OR "deadlines"."basis" = 'predicted') AND ("deadlines"."basis" <> 'predicted' OR "deadlines"."precision" IN ('window', 'tbd'))

dl_zone_ck.name: dl_zone_ck
dl_zone_ck.value: CASE "deadlines"."tz_mode" WHEN 'applicant_local' THEN "deadlines"."time_zone" IS NULL AND "deadlines"."precision" IN ('exact', 'date_only') ELSE "deadlines"."time_zone" IS NOT NULL OR "deadlines"."precision" IN ('month_only', 'rolling', 'tbd') END

ers_verified_ck.name: ers_verified_ck
ers_verified_ck.value: "eligibility_rule_sets"."state" = 'draft' OR ("eligibility_rule_sets"."hash" IS NOT NULL AND "eligibility_rule_sets"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL AND "eligibility_rule_sets"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

ev_basis_ck.name: ev_basis_ck
ev_basis_ck.value: CASE "field_evidence"."basis" WHEN 'snapshot' THEN "field_evidence"."snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL WHEN 'attestation' THEN "field_evidence"."attestation_task_id" IS NOT NULL ELSE "field_evidence"."snapshot_id" IS NULL END

cycles_verified_ck.name: cycles_verified_ck
cycles_verified_ck.value: "program_cycles"."verification_state" IN ('draft', 'unverified') OR ("program_cycles"."last_verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "program_cycles"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL)
